S2D4P.core.models.cvae module

class S2D4P.core.models.cvae.cVAE(config: cVAEConfig, input_shape: ndarray, output_shape: ndarray | None = None, added_features_dim: int | None = None)

Bases: moduleABC

Conditional variational autoencoder module.

Combines a configurable cVAE architecture with an optional normalizing-flow prior, reconstruction loss, and Kullback-Leibler divergence objective.

Parameters:

  • config (cVAEConfig) – Configuration defining the architecture, latent prior, variance limits, and training objective.

  • input_shape (np.ndarray) – Shape of each model input excluding the batch dimension.

  • output_shape (np.ndarray | None) – Shape of each model output excluding the batch dimension. If None, the input shape is used.

  • added_features_dim (int | None) – Number of additional features supplied with each sample.

forward(data: BatchData, latent_sample_size=1) → cVAEOutput

Run the cVAE training or validation forward pass.

The batch target defines the posterior distribution while the model input provides conditioning information. During validation, a configured generator uses its validation output-sample count.

Parameters:

  • data (BatchData) – Batch containing targets, conditioning inputs, masks, and optional additional features.

  • latent_sample_size (int) – Number of posterior latent samples to generate for each batch element.

Returns:

Predictions, posterior parameters, latent samples, and conditional latent parameters.

Return type:

cVAEOutput

init_loss_function(reconstruction_loss: Losspipeline)

Initialize the reconstruction and Kullback-Leibler losses.

The reconstruction loss is moved to the module device and a matching KLD loss is constructed with the same reduction method.

Parameters:

reconstruction_loss (Losspipeline) – Reconstruction loss pipeline used during cVAE training.

Raises:

RuntimeError – If a normalizing-flow prior is configured but the reconstruction loss does not use sum reduction.

predict(data: BatchData, latent_sample_size: int = 1, nstds: int = 1, latent_samples: Tensor | None = None, output_sample_size: int = 1, chunk_size: int | None = None) → cVAEOutput

Generate predictions from the cVAE latent prior.

Latent samples can be generated internally or supplied explicitly. An optional normalizing flow transforms prior samples before generation. During training, generator-enabled architectures use the configured number of training noise samples.

Parameters:

  • data (BatchData) – Batch containing conditioning inputs, masks, and optional additional features.

  • latent_sample_size (int) – Number of latent samples generated for each batch element.

  • nstds (int) – Standard-deviation multiplier used during latent prior sampling.

  • latent_samples (torch.Tensor | None) – Optional explicitly supplied latent samples. If None, samples are generated from the configured prior.

  • output_sample_size (int) – Number of stochastic outputs generated for each latent sample.

  • chunk_size (int | None) – Number of latent samples processed in each generation chunk. If None, all latent samples are processed together.

Returns:

Generated predictions and associated conditional latent parameters.

Return type:

cVAEOutput

Bases: moduleConfigABC

Configuration for a conditional variational autoencoder module.

Parameters:

  • Architecture (cVAEArchSelector | None) – Selector defining the cVAE architecture.

  • posterior_variance_limits (list[float | None, float | None] | tuple[float | None, float | None] | None) – Optional lower and upper bounds on posterior variance.

  • prior_flow_config (NormalizedFlowConfig | None) – Optional normalizing-flow configuration defining the latent prior.

  • combined_CGCN_weight (float | None) – Weight assigned to the prior-sampled reconstruction loss when combining it with the standard cVAE training objective.

  • load_dir (str | None) – Path to a saved module checkpoint from which architecture and prior-flow settings are restored.

Bases: OutputABC

Container for conditional variational autoencoder outputs.

Parameters:

  • mu (torch.Tensor | None) – Mean of the posterior latent distribution.

  • log_var (torch.Tensor | None) – Log-variance of the posterior latent distribution.

  • samples (torch.Tensor | None) – Samples drawn from the posterior latent distribution.

  • cond_mu (torch.Tensor | None) – Mean or embedding produced from the conditioning input.

  • cond_log_var (torch.Tensor | None) – Log-variance of the conditional latent distribution when explicitly parameterized.

  • deterministic_guess (bool) – Whether output represents only the deterministic guess branch.

class S2D4P.core.models.deterministic.deterministic(config: deterministicConfig, input_shape: ndarray, output_shape: ndarray | None = None, added_features_dim: int | None = None)

Bases: moduleABC

Deterministic model module.

Wraps a configured deterministic architecture and reconstruction loss while providing common training-loss, forward, and prediction interfaces.

Parameters:

  • config (deterministicConfig) – Configuration defining the deterministic architecture.

  • input_shape (np.ndarray) – Shape of each model input excluding the batch dimension.

  • output_shape (np.ndarray | None) – Shape of each model output excluding the batch dimension. If None, the input shape is used.

  • added_features_dim (int | None) – Number of additional features supplied with each sample.
